infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Coastwise uses the camera only when you choose to record a supervised drive review.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Coastwise uses your location during an active coached drive to provide route guidance. Location is not sent with AI debriefs or family sync.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Coastwise uses the microphone only when you choose to include audio in a local drive recording.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Coastwise to record an optional local drive review.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Coastwise to include optional audio in a local drive review.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Coastwise to coach an active supervised drive.
